youtube.title: Van Gogh's landlord called his sunflowers ugly. Big mistake 🌻 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Vincent van Gogh painted 7 Sunflowers… and sold ONE painting in his whole life. 🌻

His brother Theo paid the bills. The landlord was not a fan.

Sunflowers or rent money? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Van Gogh painted seven versions of Sunflowers (1888–89), lived on money from his brother Theo, an art dealer, and is said to have sold only one painting in his lifetime (The Red Vineyard, 1890, for 400 francs). In 1987 one of the Sunflowers sold for about $40 million.
